description: The rankings and « best for » pages (lightest, fastest, highest payload, price bands, abilities). Without `slug`, the pages the data supports today; with a slug (French or English address), the robots in order with value, source and verification day. Each ranking is ordered by one published criterion. `locale: "fr"` for French.

locale.description: Language of the texts and addresses: "fr" (default) or "en". The figures and the sources are identical.

slug.description: Address of one ranking page, from the list.
